item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
• Restores the Swift source file that was corrupted in the first source snapshot. • Builds the universal app with one Xcode build job at a time to avoid runner stalls.
CS Agent can now prepare a code patch for a project folder you choose.
• Review the supported source-file list and choose exactly which files NOVA may read for the request. • NOVA proposes a unified diff for existing files only. The app checks that paths stay in the selected project and that the source has not changed since it was read. • Inspect each file’s diff, select the files you want, and confirm before applying. NOVA saves local backups first. • The workflow does not run commands, builds or tests, and does not commit or push.
• macOS marketing version: 2.0.0 • Build number: 42 • The release includes the universal app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 13 or later. • The app is ad-hoc signed, not signed with an Apple Developer ID, and not notarized; macOS may ask you to approve it on first launch.
